title: Quito exposure model (GEM TREQ)
credits: Exposure model: GEM Foundation, TREQ project — Calderón A., Yepes-Estrada C., Silva V. (2022), github.com/gem/treq-riesgo-urbano, CC BY-SA 4.0; historic-centre survey by C. Celi and collaborators (PUCE).
changes: Branch br2: the 936 HBET (11-60 storey) buildings written as HEX:1 keep br1's HBET range (taxonomy rebuilt).
Assets joined to Overture building footprints (inside, else the nearest within the tolerance) and aggregated per footprint (dominant class by built area) and per hexagon.
Assets summed per zone, parish and barrio by ID; the GEM TREQ polygons of those units (Quito/Riesgo/Event_based/45297, geometry only) rasterised on the page's DEM grid.
OpenQuake vulnerability classes grouped into 12 families (material, system and ductility, without the height).
Costs rounded to 1 000 USD and night occupants to 0.1 in the binary files.
branch_note: TREQ D2.3.5 §4.3.1: four exposure models, each a modelling hypothesis; the labels describe what each branch changes in the data.
